## Description

Briefly describe the changes introduced in this pull request and the problem they solve.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality or routing logic)
- [ ] Upstream skill addition/update (requires registry update, license check, and credit regeneration)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Infrastructure / CI update

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).
- [ ] All automated tests pass locally: `npm test`
- [ ] Fast repository checks pass: `npm run check`
- [ ] (If registry was modified) Credits and catalog cards have been regenerated: `npm run credits`
- [ ] (If registry was modified) Release gate passes: `npm run ready`
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or third-party skill bodies have been committed.
